_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} m'gemu ya Liar's Dice ya wachezaji {num_players}.
Mwiko:
- Pa zamu zako, ungathe kuchita:
  1) Panga ofala yatsopano ndi wingi wapamwamba kapena uso wapamwamba (kapena zote mbili) kuposa ya pano; yaani, '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Itana ofala ya mwisho kwa kulemba '[Call]'.

Ukaitana:
  - Ukakhala kwamba kuna uso wa thamani ya ofala yoyose mwa mabwino yote pakhala pansi kuposa ya ofala, m'pangaji wa ofala ya mwisho atapoteza bwino limoza.
  - Mwachilamo, itani atapoteza bwino limoza.
Mchezaji amene atafika pa bwino sifuri atachotsedwa. Mchezaji wa mwisho atakhalira.

board.new_round:
Mzunguko mpya - Dadu zilizobaki: {dice_summary}
Dadu zako za sasa ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} anaita! Nambari yake ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni CHINI ya {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (anayetoa ofala ya mwisho) anapoteza die moja.
call.caller_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} anaita! Nambari yake ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni >= {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (anayeita) anapoteza die moja.

action.bid_announce: Mchezaji {player_id} anafanya ofa ya {quantity} ya thamani ya uso {face_value}.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Kugwiritsa ntchito kosiyanitsa bwino ngati '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]'. Kugwiritsa ntchito kwa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Malo aatsopano {new_quantity} ambalo ndi opabwino kuliko la sasa {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Thambo la nyuso latsopano {new_face_value} lililo pabwino kuliko la sasa {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Ivyo ŵapika vikayananga waka na ivyo ŵakapelekanga pa nyengo iyo.
bid_reason.face_range: Vinthu ivyo vikuwoneka kuti ni vyapadera vikwenera kuŵa pakati pa 1 na 6.
